name: Working For God
overview: Scripture reveals that working for God is both a divine calling and a source of blessing. From the beginning, God placed man in the Garden of Eden to cultivate and keep it, showing that labor is part of God’s design for humanity (Genesis 2:15). The diligent are promised leadership and profit in their efforts, while idle talk leads to poverty (Proverbs 12:24, 14:23). Committing our work to the Lord ensures stability and success, as with God, nothing is impossible (Proverbs 16:3; Luke 1:37). Ultimately, God’s favor establishes the work of our hands, highlighting the importance of aligning our labor with His purposes (Psalms 90:17).
